name: Van livery
line: Big sign-painted lettering like the side of your work van, with your phone number huge and one tap from a call.

name: Work order
line: Laid out like the job ticket you hand a customer: services as line items with prices, and a quote form that fills in like a work order.

name: Trusted local
line: Plain and reassuring: customer words first, your face and your promise, and before-and-after photos of real jobs.
